title: Remote Water Resilience Controller development study

target.reason: Protected holdout, independent final evaluation, release binding, cross-host evidence, and operational lifecycle evidence are not yet complete.

planner_may_not: append directly to the intent journal
modify checkpoints, thresholds, scenarios, or evidence

hard_gates: No declared safety invariant violation in any development scenario.
Exact deterministic replay from identical identified inputs.
Exact monotonically increasing intent sequence across checkpoint restart.
Experimental contract-profile and assurance-case schema validation.

selection_objective.primary: Reduce total pump starts across the declared scenario suite.
selection_objective.selection_rule: Hard gates dominate. The objective is evaluated only after every hard gate passes.

requirements: Scenario identities and expected outcomes remain inaccessible to generator and candidate agents until selection is frozen.
The final evaluator is independently identified and cannot alter thresholds after observing candidates.
The holdout includes novel demand, outage, telemetry, restart, corruption, and boundary combinations.
Final evidence is run on at least two physical hosts and one independent architecture when available.
